profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer/Tech Lead at Apple

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer/Tech Lead
positions.description: Developer productivity, distributed systems, and ML-assisted development

positions.title: Build Engineer
positions.description: Build infrastructure, integration, and triage engineer for iOS, tvOS, watchOS, and Apple applications. Lead for iOS 6, 7 and watchOS 1.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Monitoring service for the ITA passenger service system

positions.title: Junior Programmer
positions.description: Spearheaded the development of an intranet system for the company built with PHP/MySQL and developed a variety of administrative maintenance software for Linux platforms including a complete system backup solution.

positions.title: Senior Administrative Assistant
positions.description: Developed a web administration system in PHP/MySQL for the management of server and software configurations.

positions.title: Server Administrator
positions.description: Administration of a Debian GNU/Linux based webserver located remotely in Texas. Maintenance of the Apache web server, MySQL database engine, and PHP-based frameworks on a system processing millions of page views daily.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked with a small team to produce web sites, interactive media, and printed material.
